description: No mechanism exists for data subjects to object to processing based on legitimate interests or public task grounds. Controllers must cease processing unless compelling legitimate grounds exist.
applicability: Applicable when processing is based on legitimate interests (Art. 6.1.f) or public task (Art. 6.1.e). Must enable objection handling and assessment.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of objection handling procedures and processing controls. Verify ability to receive, assess, and act on objections.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
